author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
If you have trouble finishing drywall with a trowel, use a 24-inch drywall skimming blade instead. This method leaves a perfectly smooth coat of joint compound with no drag lines and is an easy drywall tip for beginners. If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Hope you enjoy. Cheers!
